title: China to enhance AI education in primary, secondary schools (gov.cn / Xinhua, Dec 3, 2024)
notes: gov.cn (State Council portal, Xinhua), 2024-12-03. MOE circular: explore AI education in primary/secondary schools; establish curriculums, incorporate AI into routine teaching, regular evaluations. Progression: early primary hands-on; senior primary+junior high understand/apply; senior high project creation + cutting-edge apps. AI section added to national smart education platform; colleges/research institutes/high-tech cos to open AI labs/exhibition halls. Minister Huai Jinpeng 'gold key' quote. 184 pilot base schools selected Feb 2024.
